meta.source: Curated action-verb list for evaluation and award bullets
meta.notes: Not Air Force reference data and not transcribed from an official source, so it stays marked stub. Transcribed on 2026-09-18 from a circulated Word document of action verbs with three synonyms each, then cleaned by hand: verbs are kept in the past tense a bullet uses, `base` is the dictionary form the synonym lookup keys on, and `synonyms` are dictionary forms so they can be put back into whatever tense the selected word is in (see lib/text/synonyms.ts). Entries whose synonyms were garbled or belonged to another word were corrected, and a few that are not bullet verbs were dropped. Extended the same day with the action verb table from The Tongue and Quill (AFH 33-337), transcribed from an image of the table because e-Publishing refuses automated requests: entries on that table carry `tq: true`, and the 40 it added that were not already listed have hand-picked synonyms. The Bench shows these ahead of the dictionary when a listed verb is selected; the Verbs page lists them all with widths.
